                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਭਾਰਤ ਸਰਕਾਰ ਡਾਇਗਨੌਸਟਿਕ ਸਮਰੱਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਆਰਟੀਫੀਸ਼ੀਅਲ ਇੰਟੈਲੀਜੈਂਸ (AI) ਅਤੇ ਮਸ਼ੀਨ ਲਰਨਿੰਗ (ML) ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਉੱਨਤ ਤਕਨਾਲੋਜੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਏਕੀਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਕੇ ਈ-ਸੰਜੀਵਨੀ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ ਦਾ ਵਿਸਤਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਆਮ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਗਰੂਕਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਇਸਨੂੰ ਅਪਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਯਤਨ ਵੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n111:T1992,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Steam contains extra latent heat released during condensation..

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Steam at 100°C contains latent heat: Steam has undergone a phase change from liquid to gas, absorbing a significant amount of latent heat of vaporization. This heat is released when steam condenses upon contact with skin, causing a more severe burn.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Latent heat addition: The latent heat is much greater than the heat contained by boiling water at the same temperature. When steam condenses into water on the skin, it releases this stored energy, intensifying the burn. Hence, the severity of steam burns is higher compared to boiling water burns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Condensation process: During condensation, steam transitions to liquid, releasing its latent heat of vaporization (approximately 2260 kJ/kg for water). This adds to the heat transferred to the skin, making the injury more severe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Steam's molecular energy: Steam molecules possess higher kinetic energy due to the gaseous state. When these molecules condense, the energy is transferred to the surface, increasing heat transfer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Boiling water lacks latent heat: Boiling water at 100°C only transfers heat based on its temperature and specific heat. It does not have the latent heat present in steam, making burns from boiling water comparatively less severe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Physical behavior of steam: Steam's gaseous nature allows it to spread and stick to the surface, transferring heat rapidly. This contributes to the intensity of the burn.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Latent Heat of Vaporization:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The latent heat of vaporization is the energy required to convert 1 kg of liquid into vapor without changing its temperature. For water at 100°C, this is approximately 2260 kJ/kg.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • When steam condenses, it releases the same amount of heat, which adds to the thermal energy delivered to the skin upon contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Comparison of Heat Transfer:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Boiling water at 100°C transfers heat based only on its specific heat capacity, which is lower compared to the latent heat released by steam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For instance, the specific heat capacity of water is 4.18 kJ/kg°C, whereas the latent heat of steam is far greater.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Applications of Steam:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Steam is widely used in industries for heat transfer, sterilization, and power generation due to its high energy content and heat-carrying capacity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The latent heat of steam makes it effective in processes like autoclaving and cleaning where high-temperature exposure is required.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Steam vs Boiling Water:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Steam contains both sensible heat (heat due to temperature rise) and latent heat, making it more harmful.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Boiling water only delivers heat based on its temperature and specific heat, resulting in less severe burns compared to steam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nప్రకటన 2: ఇది ప్రధానంగా హుర్కా డ్రమ్ ద్వారా ఆడిస్తారు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nపైన ఇవ్వబడిన ప్రకటనలలో ఏది సరైనది/ఏవి సరైనవి?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "2 మాత్రమే"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 & 2 రెండూ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "1 మాత్రమే"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 గానీ 2 గానీ కాదు"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "mr": {"value": "विधान 1: झोरा हा कुमाऊँमध्ये हंगामी जत्रांमध्ये केला जाणारा समूह नृत्य आहे.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nविधान 2: या नृत्याला मुख्यतः हुडका ढोलकीची साथ असते.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Statement 1: Jhora is a group dance performed in Kumaon during seasonal fairs.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Jhora dance is a traditional group dance form practiced in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It is predominantly performed during seasonal fairs and other festive occasions, symbolizing unity, joy, and celebration among the community.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Men and women form a circle and dance to the rhythm of folk songs, creating an atmosphere of celebration and harmony. Hence, statement 1 is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Statement 2: It is mainly accompanied by the Hurka drum.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Hurka drum is a traditional musical instrument widely used in Uttarakhand, including during the Jhora dance. It provides the rhythmic beats essential for the performance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The combination of the Hurka drum and folk songs enhances the cultural significance of the dance, making it an integral part of the region's traditions. Hence, statement 2 is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hence, the correct answer is Both 1 and 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Jhora Dance:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Jhora is a form of folk dance that reflects the cultural heritage of the Kumaon region in Uttarakhand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This dance is usually performed during the spring season and other festive celebrations, particularly during fairs like Bikhauti.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Jhora dance holds a significant place in the social fabric of Kumaon, as it brings the community together regardless of caste, age, or gender.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hurka Drum:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Hurka is a small drum made of wood and animal skin. It is played using a stick, creating a rhythmic sound that is central to folk performances in Uttarakhand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Hurka drum is not only used in the Jhora dance but also in other traditional dance forms like Hurka Baul, which narrates folk tales through music and dance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Significance of Kumaoni Dance and Music:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The folk dances and music of Kumaon, such as Jhora, are integral to the cultural identity of Uttarakhand. They portray themes of love, nature, and community bonding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • These performances are often accompanied by traditional musical instruments like the Hurka, Dhol, and Damau, adding vibrancy to the cultural expression.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Other Folk Dances of Uttarakhand:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Apart from Jhora, other popular folk dances in Uttarakhand include Chholiya, which is a sword dance performed by the Kumaoni Rajputs, and Ramman, a UNESCO-recognized cultural performance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Barada Nati is another famous dance form from the Garhwal region, performed during marriages and festivals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Cultural Importance:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The folk dances and music of Uttarakhand are a way of preserving and promoting the region's rich cultural heritage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • These art forms also act as a medium to pass down traditions, stories, and values from one generation to the next.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          सही उत्तर 1 और 2 दोनों है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • कथन 1: झोरा एक सामूहिक नृत्य है जो कुमाऊं में मौसमी मेलों के दौरान किया जाता है।\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • झोरा नृत्य उत्तराखंड के कुमाऊं क्षेत्र में प्रचलित एक पारंपरिक सामूहिक नृत्य रूप है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • यह मुख्य रूप से मौसमी मेलों और अन्य उत्सवों के अवसरों पर किया जाता है, जो समुदाय के बीच एकता, खुशी और उत्सव का प्रतीक है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • पुरुष और महिलाएं एक घेरा बनाते हैं और लोक गीतों की लय पर नृत्य करते हैं, जिससे उत्सव और सद्भाव का माहौल बनता है। इसलिए, कथन 1 सही है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
