                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The services listed under Article 312 currently include the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFoS).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Thus, the mention of “Security Services” under Article 312 is factually incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hence, the correct answer is Only 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Article 312 of the Indian Constitution:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Article 312 empowers the Parliament to create new All India Services, such as the IAS and IPS, upon the recommendation and approval of the Rajya Sabha through a special resolution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The purpose of All India Services is to maintain administrative uniformity across states while ensuring integration with the central government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • These services are governed by specific rules, and their members can serve both in state and central capacities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Key Features of All India Services:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Dual Governance: Members of these services serve both the Union and State governments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Recruitment: Recruitment is conducted through exams such as the UPSC Civil Services Examination.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nStatement 2: Article 312 lists “Security Services” as part of the All India Services.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nప్రకటన 2: ఆర్టికల్ 312 “భద్రతా సేవలను” అఖిల భారత సేవలలో భాగంగా జాబితా చేస్తుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nविधान 2: अनुच्छेद 312 मध्ये \"सुरक्षा सेवा\" अखिल भारतीय सेवांचा भाग म्हणून सूचीबद्ध आहेत.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nउपरोक्तपैकी कोणते/कोणती विधान/विधाने योग्य आहे/आहेत?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "फक्त 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 आणि 2 दोन्ही नाही"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "फक्त 2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 आणि 2 दोन्ही"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "bn": {"value": "বিবৃতি 1: রাজ্যসভা বিশেষ সংখ্যাগরিষ্ঠতা দ্বারা অনুমোদন করলে সংসদ নতুন সর্বভারতীয় পরিষেবা তৈরি করতে পারে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nবিবৃতি 2: সংবিধানের 312 ধারায় \"সুরক্ষা পরিষেবা\"-কে সর্বভারতীয় পরিষেবাগুলির অংশ হিসাবে তালিকাভুক্ত করা হয়েছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nવિધાન 2: અનુચ્છેદ 312માં \"સુરક્ષા સેવાઓ\" ને અખિલ ભારતીય સેવાઓના ભાગ રૂપે સૂચિબદ્ધ કરવામાં આવી છે.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nઉપરનામાંથી કયું વિધાન/વિધાનો સાચું/સાચા છે?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "માત્ર 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 અને 2 બંનેમાંથી કોઈ નહીં"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "માત્ર 2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 અને 2 બંને"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "kn": {"value": "ಹೇಳಿಕೆ 1: ರಾಜ್ಯಸಭೆಯು ವಿಶೇಷ ಬಹುಮತದಿಂದ ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಿದರೆ ಸಂಸತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಅಖಿಲ ಭಾರತ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಬಹುದು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nಹೇಳಿಕೆ 2: ವಿಧಿ 312 “ಭದ್ರತಾ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು” ಅಖಿಲ ಭಾರತ ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nಮೇಲಿನ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ/ಇವೆ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1 ಮಾತ್ರ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 ಅಥವಾ 2 ಅಲ್ಲ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "2 ಮಾತ್ರ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 ಮತ್ತು 2 ಎರಡೂ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "ta": {"value": "கூற்று 1: ராஜ்ய சபா ஒரு சிறப்பு பெரும்பான்மையுடன் ஒப்புதல் அளித்தால், பாராளுமன்றம் புதிய அகில இந்திய சேவைகளை உருவாக்கலாம்.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nகூற்று 2: அரசியலமைப்பு விதி 312, \"பாதுகாப்பு சேவைகள்\" அகில இந்திய சேவைகளின் ஒரு பகுதியாக பட்டியலிடுகிறது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nமேலே உள்ள கூற்றுகளில் எது சரியானது/சரியானவை?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1 மட்டும்"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 அல்லது 2 இல்லை"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "2 மட்டும்"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 மற்றும் 2 இரண்டும்"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "or": {"value": "ବିବରଣୀ 1: ଯଦି ରାଜ୍ୟସଭା ଏକ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ସଂଖ୍ୟାଗରିଷ୍ଠତା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଅନୁମୋଦନ କରେ ତେବେ ସଂସଦ ନୂତନ ଅଖିଳ ଭାରତ ସେବା (All India Services) ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରିବ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nବିବରଣୀ 2: ଧାରା 312 “ସୁରକ୍ଷା ସେବା” କୁ ଅଖିଳ ଭାରତ ସେବା ର ଏକ ଅଂଶ ଭାବରେ ତାଲିକାଭୁକ୍ତ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nଉପରୋକ୍ତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବରଣୀ ସଠିକ୍ ଅଟେ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "କେବଳ 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "1 କିମ୍ବା 2 ନୁହେଁ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "କେବଳ 2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ଉଭୟ 1 ଏବଂ 2"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਕਥਨ 1: ਸੰਸਦ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਆਲ ਇੰਡੀਆ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੇਕਰ ਰਾਜ ਸਭਾ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਬਹੁਮਤ ਨਾਲ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਦੇਵੇ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nਕਥਨ 2: ਆਰਟੀਕਲ 312 “ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ” ਨੂੰ ਆਲ ਇੰਡੀਆ ਸੇਵਾਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਸੂਚੀਬੱਧ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nਉਪਰੋਕਤ ਕਥਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਹੀ ਹੈ/ਹਨ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "ਕੇਵਲ 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "ਨਾ 1 ਅਤੇ ਨਾ ਹੀ 2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "ਕੇਵਲ 2"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 ਅਤੇ 2 ਦੋਵੇਂ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Only 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Statement 1: Parliament may create new All India Services if the Rajya Sabha approves by a special majority. This statement is correct.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Article 312 of the Indian Constitution explicitly provides for the creation of new All India Services.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The process requires a resolution passed by the Rajya Sabha with a special majority (not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • All India Services include services such as the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFoS), which operate across both the Central and State governments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The creation of new services is meant to promote uniformity and efficiency in governance across India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Statement 2: Article 312 lists “Security Services” as part of the All India Services. This statement is incorrect.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Article 312 does not specifically mention “Security Services” as part of the All India Services.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The article provides a general framework for the creation of new All India Services but does not list any specific service beyond those already established.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The services listed under Article 312 currently include the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFoS).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Thus, the mention of “Security Services” under Article 312 is factually incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Hence, the correct answer is Only 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Article 312 of the Indian Constitution:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Article 312 empowers the Parliament to create new All India Services, such as the IAS and IPS, upon the recommendation and approval of the Rajya Sabha through a special resolution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The purpose of All India Services is to maintain administrative uniformity across states while ensuring integration with the central government.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • These services are governed by specific rules, and their members can serve both in state and central capacities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Key Features of All India Services:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Dual Governance: Members of these services serve both the Union and State governments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Recruitment: Recruitment is conducted through exams such as the UPSC Civil Services Examination.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Special Powers: The services ensure uniformity in governance and administration, particularly in law enforcement and public service delivery.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Incorrect Reference to "Security Services":\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • There is no mention of Security Services in Article 312 of the Constitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • However, the Indian Police Service (IPS), which is part of the All India Services, plays a crucial role in national security and law enforcement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Special Majority in Rajya Sabha:\n\n\t
