                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Principal (P) = 40,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Amount (A) = 53,240

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Rate (r) = 10% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A = P (1 + r/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1 + 10/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 ÷ 40,000 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.331 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.1 × 1.1 × 1.1 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (1.1)3 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ t = 3 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ 40,000 will become 53,240 in 3 years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            मूलधन (P) = 40,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            मिश्रधन (A) = 53,240

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दर (r) = 10% प्रति वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A = P (1 + r/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1 + 10/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 ÷ 40,000 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\nఇవ్వబడినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1 + 10/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 ÷ 40,000 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.331 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.1 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (1.1)3 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ t = 3 ବର୍ଷ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ 40,000 ଟଙ୍କା 3 ବର୍ଷରେ 53,240 ଟଙ୍କା ହେବ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਮੂਲਧਨ (P) = 40,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਰਾਸ਼ੀ (A) = 53,240

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਦਰ (r) = 10% ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਸਾਲ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A = P (1 + r/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਗਣਨਾਵਾਂ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1 + 10/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 = 40,000 (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 53,240 ÷ 40,000 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.331 = (1.1)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1.1 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ (1.1)3 = 1.331

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ t = 3 ਸਾਲ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ 40,000 ਰੁਪਏ 3 ਸਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 53,240 ਰੁਪਏ ਹੋ ਜਾਣਗੇ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Profit : Cost Price = 3 : 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Ratio of SP : Profit = SP / Profit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Let Cost Price (CP) = 5x and Profit = 3x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 5x + 3x = 8x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Ratio of SP : Profit = SP / Profit = 8x / 3x = 8 : 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 8 : 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            लाभ : क्रय मूल्य = 3 : 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
