                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is: Option (2) i.e. Absence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word “presence” refers to the state of being present or existing in a place or situation. (उपस्थिति)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: Her presence at the event was reassuring.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • “Absence” is the state of being away or not present; it is the direct opposite of presence. (अनुपस्थिति)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The absence of his friend made the party less enjoyable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • In the analogy, as joy relates to presence (something felt when something is present), sorrow relates to absence (something felt when something or someone is missing).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is- Absence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Vanishment (लुप्त होना): The act of disappearing completely.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The magician’s vanishment amazed the audience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Release (मुक्ति): The act of setting someone or something free.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The prisoner’s release brought joy to his family.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Quietude (शांति): A state of stillness, calmness, and quiet in a place.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The passage repeatedly emphasizes that sorrow and joy are interconnected and that sorrow gives depth and meaning to joy.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 2: The author does not criticize emotional imbalance but embraces emotional duality.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is: Option (1) i.e. A blended pattern.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The word “mosaic” in the passage refers to a combination of different elements coming together to create a complete and beautiful picture or pattern. (विभिन्न रंगों और टुकड़ों से बना सुन्दर मिश्रण/सजावट)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The city’s culture is a mosaic of traditions from around the world.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Here, the author uses “mosaic of consciousness” to describe how diverse emotions and experiences (such as joy and sorrow) blend together to make life richer and more human. (यहाँ 'mosaic' का अर्थ है- मिश्रित पैटर्न, जिसमें विभिन्न भावनाएँ और अनुभव मिलकर जीवन की सुंदरता बनाते हैं।)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: Life’s mosaic is made up of both happy and sad moments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Hence, in this context, “mosaic” most likely means “a blended pattern”.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Therefore, the correct answer is- A blended pattern

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A rigid structure (कठोर संरचना): Something that is inflexible or does not change its form.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The old bridge was built as a rigid structure to withstand heavy loads.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A hollow emotion (खोखला भाव): A feeling that lacks true substance, depth, or meaning.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: His apology sounded like a hollow emotion, without real regret.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A musical rhythm (संगीत की लय): A repeated pattern of sounds or beats in music.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The dancers moved in perfect time to the musical rhythm.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
